author: blu
body: Proves Mind Twist: X-discard. "Target player discards X cards at random." compiles to DiscardX. It is castable only with mana to spare beyond the fixed cost; casting pours all remaining mana into X, and the opponent discards that many cards. With three black floating and the {B} fixed cost paid, X = 3, so a five-card hand loses three to the graveyard.
